name: The East India Company's Factory, Canton
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view from across the Pearl River to the eastern end of the 'factory' site at Canton (Guangzhou) allotted to the trading bases or 'factories' of the Western trading nations; the English, Dutch and Creek 'factories' can be seen, with British and Dutch flags sketched in. See E.1776-1928 for a drawing
